name: Death Simulator
summary: You are Death's newest employee, tasked with collecting souls across a supernatural world where the afterlife operates as a sprawling corporation. Armed with spectral chains and soul-hunting arrows, you must meet daily quotas while navigating dynamic combat encounters—from rooftop pursuits to hellish battlegrounds. Precision timing determines success as you hunt souls in first-person perspective, with every collection feeling immediate and consequential. Progress through Death's hierarchy, unlock new abilities, and advance your eternal career across photorealistic environments rendered in Unreal Engine 5, where otherworldly horror meets meticulous detail.
